CustomField.formula: TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & ", " & IF( OR( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - (4/24)), 12, 2 ) ) = 0, VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - (4/24) ), 12, 2 ) ) = 12 ), "12", TEXT( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - (4/24) ), 12, 2 ) ) - IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - (4/24)), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, 0, 12 ) ) ) & ":" & MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - (4 /24)), 15, 2 ) & ":" & MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - (4/24) ), 18, 2 ) & " " & IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - (4/24)), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, "AM", "PM" ) & " EST"
CustomField.label: Message Date
